name: zinc finger and BTB domain containing 46
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ZBTB46 encodes zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 46. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Amphicrine-like carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
